sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frames left->right, frame_size each

tree_apple_orchard_sway.anchor: bottom-centre (same anchor as props/tree_apple_orchard.png; frame is 10px (1x) wider on each side so the canopy never clips)
tree_apple_orchard_sway.note: sway 16 f @ 8 fps, ~4.0 px canopy bend at 1x, base pinned below 42% height; randomise start frame + speed_scale (0.85-1.15)

tree_apple_orchard_shadow_sway.anchor: frame top-left = top-left of the matching tree_apple_orchard_sway frame; draw on the ground layer under all props
tree_apple_orchard_shadow_sway.note: cast shadow that moves with the canopy: frame i is the projection of sway frame i (light from the top-left, shear 0.62, squash 0.30, soft 2.2 px)

old_windmill_sails.anchor: frame centre = sail hub; place the frame centre at (-39, -150) px (1x) from the old_windmill_body bottom-centre anchor ((-78, -300) at 2x), draw above the body
old_windmill_sails.note: 90 deg per loop (4 symmetric sails), 7.5 deg per frame; one full turn every 4.44 s; 12 f @ 10.8 fps

old_windmill_sails_flat.anchor: frame centre = sail hub (same placement as the strip)
old_windmill_sails_flat.note: un-squashed sails at 0 deg for a rotation shader: rotate uv about the centre, then divide y by 0.9
